Structural comparison reports changed positions and retains original values. Use it to review edits to a schema; it cannot prove semantic compatibility or native equivalence.

Keep unfamiliar extension content and exact literal carriers intact when editing. Native projections report constraints they cannot represent. A refusal retains the original source for recovery.
